stem.text: The graph shows changes in the volume of the ventricles during the cardiac cycle.

stem.alt: Graph of volume in arbitrary units against stages of the cardiac cycle. The volume is high and level at the start, falls to a minimum labelled R, then rises to a high plateau during diastole. Points labelled P and R, and dashed lines marking atrial systole, ventricular systole and diastole are shown.

stem.text: Which valves open and close at P and R?
